correctness.rationale: The claim is finite and exhaustively replayable. The verifier constructs all \(720\) permutations, all threshold edges, enumerates every four-clique and five-clique without heuristic pruning, obtains \(3{,}960\) and \(0\) respectively, checks every maximum has six distances equal to \(10\), and exhausts the stated \(1{,}440\)-map symmetry action into four orbits. No timeout or partial enumeration is used.

value.rationale: This is a complete extremal classification at the smallest \(n\) in the published infinite \(P(n,d)=4\) regime and at its endpoint \(d=10\) when \(n=6\). The census adds structural information absent from the optimum value: every optimum is equidistant and the full extremal set collapses to four natural symmetry types. This is a natural boundary classification rather than an arbitrary slice.
